Q8537.reason: Punishment is a social practice that exists independently of the moral reasons offered for it, so the practice and its justification must be kept apart.

Q6097.reason: In most states today fee-tail language is read as a fee simple absolute, so the cousin took the whole estate and the later deed leaves the niece nothing.

Q8324.reason: Agitated drug-seeking fits withdrawal with less dopamine in the synaptic cleft; dopamine-cell death produces parkinsonism, not this presentation.
